summary: Prepare reproducible plugin and marketplace archives, reviewable notes and an evidence-bound release manifest.
acceptance: Bind a dry-run candidate to its exact source, tests and package checksums. Require reviewed changes on main and retain explicit publication approval.
validation: CI matrix, candidate negative tests, checksum comparison after clean extraction, protected settings readback and release rehearsal.
securityImpact: Build and release permissions only. The local runtime authorization and secret destinations retain their existing boundaries.
